name: Noose of Every Neck

abilities.name: Smother (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The noose smothers one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While smothered, the target is blinded and restrained, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the noose, and takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the noose's turns. The noose can have only one creature smothered at a time. If the noose takes 15 damage or more in a single turn from the smothered creature, the noose must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the noose. If the noose dies, a smothered creature pulls free prone by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The noose makes two Lash attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Hoisted.

actions.name: Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Hoisted
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet of the noose must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 19 (3d12) necrotic damage, be pulled up to 20 feet straight toward the noose, and be knocked prone.

generation.userConcept: a hangman's rope that remembers every neck
generation.cite: composition after Giant Crocodile (CR 5) jaws + Giant Toad (CR 1) swallow — print swallows at LOW CR

other_edition.lore: Stitched from every hanging ever performed on a single gallows beam, the rope came loose one moonless night and now moves between towns to find new throats, convinced each death it takes adds another neck to its name.
